chapter.verse: Pentecost ni a tun ciangin amaute a vekun mun khat ah omkhawm uh hi.
Tua laitak huihpi nung bangin vantung pan huging khat hong kikhawhsuk a, amau' tutna inn sung teng kheeng hi.
Meikuang kizel bangin leiite hong kilang a, amaute khat ciat tungah tu hi.
Tua ciangin amaute a vekun Kha Siangtho tawh kidim uh a, Kha in a genkhiatsak bangin kam dangte tawh thugen uh hi.
Tu-in vanpi nuai, gam citeng pan Jew mi thuzui citakte Jerusalem khua ah om uh hi.
Hih huging a om ciangin mihonpi hong kikhawm uh a, sawltakte' thugente mi kim in amau' pau tek tawh za uh ahih manin lungbuai uh hi.
Lamdang sa mahmah uh ahih manin, “Hih thugengen mite a vekun Galilee mi hilo ahi uh hiam?
Eite khat ciat in amau' thugente i pianpih pau tek tawh i zak pen a bangci dan hiam?
Ei pen Parthia mi, Mede mi, Elam mi, leh Mesopotamia gam, Judea gam leh Cappadocia gam, Pontus gam leh Asia gam,
Phrygia gam leh Pamphylia gam, Egypt gam, leh Cyrene khuapi gei Libya gam sung kimkhat, cih tenga teengte leh Rome khuapi pana a hawhte i hi a,
Jew mite leh biakna lutthakte, Crete mite leh Arab mite, a nam nihin i om hi. Hinapi hih mite' gen Pasian' sep nalianpite tawh kisai thu teng eimau' kam ciat tawh i za hi,” ci uh hi.
A vekun lamdang sa-in lungbuai mahmah uh a, “Hih a khiatna bang ahi hiam?” kici uh hi.
Ahi zongin kimkhat in zahpih uh a, “Lengtui suakcil a tam dawn lua uh hi lel,” ci uh hi.

Himah taleh sawmlekhatte tawh Peter dingto-in mihonpi kiangah a aw sangkhanin hih bangin thugen hi: “Judea mite leh Jerusalem khua-a om mite khempeuh aw, hih thu na theih nadingun ka thugente limtak na ngai un.
A hang pen tu-in zingsang nai kua hi pan a, na upmawh bangun hih mite a amkham uh hilo hi.
Hih pen kamsang Joel tungtawna kigen thu ahi hi:

“‘Hunleni nunungte ah hih bang hong hiding hi,’ ci-in Pasian in tangko a, ‘Mi khempeuh' tungah ka Kha ka buak ding hi, na tapate leh na tanute un kamsang ding hi, na khangnote un muhtuam ngah ding hi, na khanghamte un mangman ding hi.
Keima' sila pasalte leh sila numeite tung nangawn ah ka Kha ka buak ding a, tua hun ciangin amaute in kamsang ding uh hi.
Tua ciangin tung thangvan ah nalamdangte, nuai simlei ah kihilna limte, sisan, meikuang leh meikhu lompi cihte ka lak ding hi.
Topa' ni, a thupi a vanglian ni, hong tun ma-in ni pen khuamial suak ding a, kha zong sisan bang ding hi.
Tua ciangin Topa' min tawh thungen khempeuh hotkhiat ngah ding uh hi,’ ci hi.
“Israel mite aw, hih thute za ta un: Nazareth khuami Jesu, na theihsa bangun Pasian in ama' tungtawnin nalamdangte leh kihilna lim lamdangte bawlna tawh note laka hong lahtel mipa—
hih Jesu pen Pasian' geelkholhna leh theihkholhna a om bangin apna thuak a, thukhun pualam mite' khut tawh amah na khailum uh hi.
Pasian in sihna gaute sutkhia-in amah thokiksak hi; a hang pen sihna in amah lencip ding cih a piang theilo thu ahi hi.
Amah tawh kisai David in hih bangin na gen hi: “‘Ka mai-a a om tawntung Topa ka mu a, ka taklam ah amah om ahih manin ka linglawng kei hi.
Tua hangin ka lungsim lawp a, nopsakna tawh kam ka pau hi; ka pumpi zong lametna tawh busa ding hi.
A hang pen nangmah in Leinuai ah ka nunna kha na nusia kei ding a, nangma' Mi Siangtho pen pumpi muatna na tuaksak kei ding hi.
Nangmah in nuntakna lampite kei nong lak khinzo a, nong ompihna in lungdamna kidim hong suaksak hi.’
“Sanggamte aw, pupi David tawh kisai-in lungmuangtak kong gen ding a kilawm thu ah amah si-in kivui a, ama' hankhuk zong tuni dong eite' kiangah om lai hi.
David in ama' kumpi-tokhom ah ama' suanlekhakte khat tusak ding ci-in khapna tawh Pasian kiciam khinzo cih, kamsang khat ahihna tawh thei ahih manin
Khris a thawhkik ding thu mukholin gen a, Leinuai ah amah kinusia lo, a sa zong muat lo, ci hi.
Hih Jesu pen Pasian in thokiksak a, tua thu ah kote khempeuh teci ka hi uh hi.
Tua hi a, Pasian' taklam mun ah pahtawina ngahin Pa' kiangpan kamciam Kha Siangtho sang khin ahih manin amah in nomau' muh leh zak ahi hih thu hong sungkhia ahi hi.
A hang pen David in amahmah vantung ah kahto lo napi hih bangin na gen hi: “‘Topa in ka Topa' kiangah ci hi: "Ka taklam ah tu in aw,
na galte na khe-ngakna tokhom ka suahsak mateng maw."’ ”
“Tua ahih manin hih na khailup uh Jesu pen Pasian in Topa leh Khris ahi dingin bawl khinzo cih Israel innkuanbup in ciantak thei ta un.”
Hih thute a zak uh ciangin mite nakpi lunghimawh uh a, “Sanggamte aw, bang ka cih ding uh hiam?” ci-in Peter leh sawltak dangte' kiangah dong uh hi.
Peter in, “Kisik unla na mawhnate uh hong kimaisakna hangin na vekun Jesu Khris' min tawh kibaptize un. Tua hileh deihguat thupha Kha Siangtho na ngah ding uh hi.
Tua kamciam pen note' ading, na tate uh' ading leh gamlapi-a om, i Topa Pasian in ama' kianga a sap mi khempeuh' ading, ahi hi,” ci hi.
Thudang tampi tawh zong khauhtakin teci pang a, “Hih lungkawi sinkawi khangmite' lakpan nomaumah kihonkhia un,” ci-in hanthawn hi.
Tua ciangin ama' thugen a sangte kibaptize uh a, tua ni-in mihing tulthum kiim kibehlap hi.
Amaute in sawltakte' hilhcianna pomkip uh a, kikholhkhopna, anlum balnenna leh thungetna nei den uh hi.
Mihing citeng' tungah zahtak launa hong tung a, nalamdangte leh kihilna limte zong sawltakte' tungtawnin tampi kibawl hi.
Tua ciangin thu-um khempeuh lom-om uh a, na khempeuh neitaang uh hi.
A neih a lamte uh zuak uh a, mi khempeuh a kitangsapna uh zui-in hawmkhia uh hi.
Amaute nisimin biakinnpi ah lungsim kituakin kikhawm uh a, inn kim ah anlum balnenin nakpi nuamna leh lungsim siangtho tawh ne tek uh hi.
Pasian phat uh a, mi khempeuh' maipha ngah uh hi. Nisimin Topa in amaute' tungah hotkhiat mi kibehlapsak hi.
